name: gizza-ai/mars-spline-regression
summary: Fit a MARS hinge-spline regression model to numeric tables

tool.description: Fit a deterministic Multivariate Adaptive Regression Splines (MARS) model to pasted numeric data. The tool grows hinge functions, prunes them by GCV, reports the explicit piecewise-linear equation, fit statistics, variable importance, knots, terms, and optional predictions for new rows. Inputs are local CSV/TSV/semicolon/pipe/whitespace tables; no network or machine-learning runtime is used.

allow_linear.description: Allow plain linear terms as candidates as well as hinge pairs. Default true.

data.description: Numeric CSV, TSV, semicolon, pipe, or whitespace table. Header row is auto-detected by default. The target column defaults to the last column.

decimals.description: Decimal places for text and CSV output. Default 4.

endspan.description: Rows to protect at each edge from becoming knots. 0 chooses an automatic span. Default 0.

features.description: Optional comma-separated feature columns by name or 1-based number. Blank means all columns except the target.

format.description: Output format: text report, CSV tables, or JSON model object. Default text.

header.description: Whether the training data has a header row. Default auto.

max_degree.description: Maximum interaction degree for hinge terms. 1 = additive piecewise-linear model; 2 or 3 allow interactions. Default 1.

max_terms.description: Maximum number of basis terms grown during the forward pass. Default 21.

minspan.description: Minimum number of rows between candidate knots. 0 chooses an automatic span. Default 0.

nprune.description: Optional cap on kept terms after pruning. 0 lets GCV choose. Default 0.

penalty.description: GCV complexity penalty per term, similar to the earth package penalty. Default 3.0.

predict.description: Optional new feature rows to score, using the same delimiter and feature order as the training data. Do not include the target column.

prune.description: Run the backward pruning pass and keep the sub-model with the best GCV score. Default true.

target.description: Target column to predict: a header name, 1-based column number, or 'last'. Default last.

thresh.description: Minimum relative RSS improvement needed to add another pair of hinge terms. Default 0.001.
